title.en: Tractor 4100 or the 17 kW pump for a village house?
title.zh: 村镇住宅选拖拉机4100还是 17 kW 泵？

description.en: Both are off-grid rural rows. The 17 kW pump is 5–8 m³/h and 30–50 m horizontal. The 4100 is 6–12 m³/h and 40–100 m / 15–45 m, with a slump cell.
description.zh: 两台都是无电网农村行。17 kW 泵是 5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m。4100 是 6–12 m³/h、40–100 m / 15–45 m，并有坍落度格。

h1.en: Tractor 4100 or the 17 kW pump for a village house?
h1.zh: 村镇住宅选拖拉机4100还是 17 kW 泵？

directAnswer.en: Use the 17 kW rural diesel when 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical are enough. Use the tractor-driven 4100 when you need 6–12 m³/h and the wider 40–100 m / 15–45 m window, and you can use the printed 40 kW tractor drive. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists both for rural self-built houses. Neither is Diesel 120.
directAnswer.zh: 5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m 够用时，用 17 kW 农村柴油泵。需要 6–12 m³/h 和更宽的 40–100 m / 15–45 m，并且能用已印的 40 kW 拖拉机带动时，用 4100。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都列为农村自建房。两台都不是柴油120。

heading.zh: 坍落度是 4100 多出来的一格

body.en: Only the 4100 prints 180–220 mm. The 17 kW pump prints hopper 0.2 m³ and 800 kg, against the 4100’s 0.25 m³ and 1300 kg. Aggregate 1–3 cm and 15 MPa appear on both. Shared pressure and stone still leave two distance tables.
body.zh: 只有 4100 印了 180–220 mm。17 kW 泵印了料斗 0.2 m³ 和 800 kg，4100 是 0.25 m³ 和 1300 kg。骨料 1–3 cm 和 15 MPa 两台都有。压力和石子相同，仍然是两张距离表。

heading.en: Frame width is 1100 mm versus 1000 mm
heading.zh: 机架宽度是 1100 mm 对 1000 mm

body.en: The rural diesel outline is 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. The 4100 outline is 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. The longer machine is the 4100. A short village line does not need the longer frame just because both pages say “rural”.
body.zh: 农村柴油泵外形是 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm。4100 外形是 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。更长的是 4100。短的村镇管路不需要仅仅因为两页都写了“农村”就用更长的机架。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say whether a tractor is available. That decides the 4100 more clearly than the word “village”. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明有没有拖拉机。这比“村镇”两个字更能决定 4100。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: The 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h. The rural diesel prints 5–8 m³/h.
answer.zh: 4100 印 6–12 m³/h。农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。
